method: Every instance of every layout file (54 configs x 3 seeds, scored and spare). Model id resolved by inst.type == "cluttered" (layout_manager.py:164-167). Declared layout mass vs class density band (class_values.json range) x bbox volume (metadata aligned bbox x layout scale). too_heavy = mass/bbox volume above the band top (a solid bbox cannot hold it). hollow = model flagged hollow_contents_dependent. light_for_solid = below half the band bottom. slip = layout mass differs from metadata.json mass by >2x or <0.5x. Groups are keyed by (task, model, verdict, layout mass, slip); hits are instance counts, split scored/spare.
